digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified CI pipeline on GitHub Actions
propositions: Workflow wall-clock duration regressed from 15-20 minutes to 30-40 minutes after mutation testing addition, driven by deterministic test execution growth and macOS subprocess contention rather than mutation itself.

Pytest execution on macOS default tier grew 870.72 seconds across commits ceea743 to 7a1863f due to ~4.1k additional selected tests and repeated expensive real-time waits (120s JIRA timeout, five 5s sleeps, 25s retry loops, AST parsing, wiki corpus recomputation).

Mutation testing landed at e0b3fdfc8e but was active in only 5/62 subsequent runs; skipped runs showed identical latency, disproving mutation as the direct critical-path cause despite its aggregate runner-minute contribution.

Org-level GitHub runner contention (5 macOS/20 total job limit) amplifies deterministic subprocess and filesystem work nonlinearly; queue times ranged median 0.72m to 17.5m across runs, accounting for variable tail latency independent of execution critical path.

Seven linked remediation tickets address specific test defects (fake clocks, injected sleepers, immutable AST caching, wiki corpus per-process cache, import benchmark optimization) without removing coverage or increasing aggregate runner consumption.
